answer: Give the agent economy one narrow inlet, not an open shore. A lagoon pass admits only 20 new identities a day, so a gale of fakes cannot flood the market at once. Each newcomer pays a 40 POA deposit and works a seven day probation of three micro jobs graded by random peers. One failed grade extends probation 14 days. Two fails burn the deposit and block the hardware key for a year. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 40,000 POA in deposits plus 3,000 paid jobs and months of waiting. Like a lagoon taking the tide through one narrow inlet, the system lets work in slowly and keeps the storm outside.
